title: I didn’t walk into 2026 carrying the same weight.
paragraphs:
I didn’t walk into 2026 carrying the same weight.
I closed the door on depression, hurt, pain, and broken seasons.
Not because life suddenly got easy — but because Jesus went first.

When Jesus comes first, prayer becomes your reflex, not your last option.
Healing starts where faith steps in.
Strength rises where surrender happens.
Provision follows obedience.

“Forget the former things; do not dwell on the past. See, I am doing a new thing!” — Isaiah 43:18–19
“The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.” — Psalm 34:18
“Seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added to you.” — Matthew 6:33

This year isn’t about pretending you were never broken.
It’s about walking forward because God restored you.
Jesus first. Always.
If this speaks to your soul, follow along — we’re walking into purpose together.
